description: Avatar system: fit the remaining equipment pieces and set the GP price of each shop item for Primary Advantage
deviation_notes: Light card created 2026-11-27 from open item 6 of QUEUE.md, when the QUEUE retired into measure/tracks.md. The archived avatar_system_20261001 delivered the base, the fit contract, the pack, and the composer on 2026-10-04 and closed on 2026-11-19. This card holds only the two results that the item names: the equipment fit of the remaining rows and the GP price of the shop items. No spec, no gates, no review. GP is in-game currency, not money, and no price is public before Daniel approves it.
